text:
paloma: Quick flagwe had a provisioning regression over a 10-hour window affecting ~19 trial tenants created 2026-04-02 -> 2026-04-03. Putting together outbound comms, mitigation details, and compensation recommendation.

ryan_cs: Can you confirm which accounts are sales-owned/high-touch so we can prep AE outreach?

paloma: High-touch list in the doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/impacted_apr_provs Top four: NimbusData, PilotAI, Papertrail, HarborBI.

ken_ops: Short infra summary: a misconfiguration in a retry backoff caused provisioning webhooks to cluster on delivery, which exposed a race that delayed index bootstrap for some tenants. We rolled a hotfix and ran a replay tool to process the backlog. Patch deployed 2026-04-04T01:12Z.

ops-bot: deploy: hotfix/2026-04-04-provision-retry-fix deployed by @ken_ops at 2026-04-04T01:12Z :white_check_mark:

paloma: Need: 1) customer-facing RCA (concise, non-technical), 2) credit decision, 3) plan for office hours + 1:1s for high-touch.

alisha: Draft RCA for customers: "We experienced a temporary delay in provisioning for a small number of trials while processing a surge of setup requests. Our team deployed a fix, completed replays for affected accounts, and verified those tenants are now available. We apologize for the disruption and are adding safeguards to avoid future recurrence."

ryan_cs: Good. Compensation proposal: automatic 20% credit for the next billing period for trials that experienced >8 hours delay, plus an optional 30-minute 1:1 for each high-touch account. Also host a 45-minute office hours session to walk through the incident and accept questions.

product-ops: From renewal risk perspective, flag NimbusData + PilotAI as needing AE outreach. Recommend offering an extra 1:1 with product + CS for those two.

ken_ops: Backfills are currently 100% for replayed setups; we revalidated indexes and ran consistency checks at 2026-04-04T03:40Z. Monitoring changes: added jitter to retry backoff and an alert for provisioning queue depth > 50.

paloma: Perfect. Action items: alisha finalize email + credit wording by EOD; ryan_cs flag AEs and start outreach to NimbusData + PilotAI; ops post final replay proof and monitoring links; product-ops coordinate product rep for the two high-touch 1:1s. I'll schedule the office hours and paste RSVP link.

ops-bot: calendarbot: office-hours event created by @paloma for 2026-04-06T16:00Z RSVP: https://redwood.internal/events/oh-2026-04-06

ryan_cs: AE owners pinged. Will include an optional credit note in their outreach.

alisha: Email draft: "We're sorry — a temporary processing issue delayed provisioning for a small set of trial accounts. We've fixed the problem and completed replays; your tenant should now be available. We're applying a 20% credit to the next billing period for trials affected for more than 8 hours, and we're offering a 30-minute 1:1 to help with any migration or configuration questions. If you'd like to join our technical office hours, RSVP here: https://redwood.internal/events/oh-2026-04-06. Please reply if you'd prefer a dedicated session"

paloma: Thanks everyone. I'll publish the note to the impacted list after we confirm the final credit mechanics with billing. Closing thread when outbound is sent.
